learning_data.name: What is Subtraction
learning_data.info: Subtraction is a method in maths, where two numbers values are taken away from each other, creating a smaller number than the two given e.g. 3-1 is 2. The sybmol representing subtraction (also known as minus) is -

learning_data.name: How to Subtract
learning_data.info: Subtracting two numbers is similar to adding them but in the reverse order, so for example 7 - 3 is 4, and utilising the original number set to create bigger numbers, we can do for example, 49 - 39 is 10.

learning_data.name: How to Subtract
learning_data.info: This methdod can also be applied to larger numbers, such as 178 - 78, which is 100.

learning_data.name: Remember
learning_data.info: Remember to use the number line method in the previous tutorial, as this will help you subtract larger numbers
